name: 83 Woodworks LLC
description: 83 Woodworks LLC is a Saco, Maine, business run by Troy Nadeau that offers custom cabinetry, CNC work and millwork. The business designs, builds and installs kitchens, home offices, closets, bath vanities, built-ins, garage storage systems and commercial millwork such as reception desks and fixtures. Its customers are mostly homeowners across Southern Maine. Projects start with planning how a space will be used, followed by fabrication and installation of the finished cabinetry. The company grew out of a flower box Troy built for his wife, which a passerby asked to buy.
